intro: Sample for Helbrim is a Horde courier task bridging Undercity alchemical experiments with Forsaken outposts in central Kalimdor. Handed down by Apothecary Zinge, it sends couriers across the sea to deliver a blighted wolf heart to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor. He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads. To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar. Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have a package for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.
This is a welcome delivery, friend. Your reward is well earned.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
